title: Lesson 5: Simple neural networks (Perceptron & MLP) — js-tools
desc: The fifth lesson of the Practical AI Engineer roadmap. The maths behind a single artificial neuron and why one Perceptron can only draw a straight line, why non-linear activations are not optional, how to assemble an MLP with torch.nn, and why initialising every weight to the same constant collapses four neurons into one.
